name: crouch-torso
title: Crouch the torso
description: Lower the torso lift to its bottom (or a requested height) for floor and low-shelf work.
use_when: The next target is low (floor, low shelf) or the head must look under something.

not_to_be_confused_with.bend: bend pitches the waist forward; crouch lowers the torso vertically.

height_m.description: Optional torso joint target in [-0.54, 0]; omit for the lowest.

postconditions.meaning: Torso lift within 3 cm of its highest position (travel height).
Torso lift joint within 2 cm of the requested position (0 = top, -0.54 = bottom).
Torso lift within 3 cm of its lowest position (floor reach).

failure.on_failure: stop and report the measured pre/postconditions; nothing is retried.

returns.success: true when every precondition held, the action ran and every postcondition holds
returns.error_code: on failure: INPUT_MISSING, INPUT_UNKNOWN, PRECONDITION_FAILED, NO_PATH, POLICY_FAILED, SUBSKILL_FAILED or POSTCONDITION_FAILED
returns.preconditions: each precondition as evaluated before moving, with holds = true/false
returns.postconditions: each postcondition as evaluated after the action, with holds = true/false
returns.outputs: the measured values listed under Outputs
